WITH assessed AS (

         MIN(r.held_cents, MAX(0, r.damage_cents - n.allowance_cents)) AS retained_cents
  FROM equipment_returns AS r
  JOIN terms_notices AS n ON n.fleet_code = r.fleet_code
   AND n.start_day = (
     SELECT MAX(t.start_day) FROM terms_notices AS t
     WHERE t.fleet_code = r.fleet_code AND t.start_day <= r.intake_day
   )
  WHERE r.damage_cents IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT return_code, source_id, retained_cents, held_cents - retained_cents AS refund_cents
FROM assessed
ORDER BY return_code ASC
